# 7413 - Dual 4-input NAND Schmitt trigger

Package DIP-14 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/7413.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/7413.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 7 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![7413 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/7413.png) | ![7413 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/nand-schmitt4.png) | ![7413 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/nand-schmitt4.png) |

The empty NAND rectangle with four inputs; its top edge runs on to the right and its bottom edge runs on to the left. What a Schmitt trigger is: a normal TTL input switches at one voltage, so a slow or noisy signal near that voltage makes the output flicker between 0 and 1 several times. A Schmitt trigger input has two switching points instead: the input must rise above about 1.7 V before the output changes, and then fall below about 0.9 V before it changes back. The gap between them (the hysteresis) means noise and slow edges give one clean change. It is used on signals from cables, switches and RC delay circuits. The input still reads as plain logic 0 or 1; only its noise tolerance differs.

How to tell it on a drawing: Edges running past the box (top to the right, bottom to the left) = Schmitt trigger input.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 6 | 1Y = NOT(1A AND 1B AND 1C AND 1D) | 1Y is the NAND of 1A, 1B, 1C, 1D. |
| 8 | 2Y = NOT(2A AND 2B AND 2C AND 2D) | 2Y is the NAND of 2A, 2B, 2C, 2D. |

## Propagation delays

All measured at VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 400 ohm, CL 15 pF.

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| any | Y | PLH | 18 | 27 |
| any | Y | PHL | 15 | 22 |

## Notes

The datasheet gives no minimum propagation delay; minNs is null (the path-delay function uses 0 ns). No setup/hold/pulse-width limits apply to a gate, so timingLimits is empty. No TI SN7413 datasheet could be downloaded (the TI links return an error page); the figures are from the NTE7413 replacement-part sheet, not an original TI/National sheet.
